items.title: Evaluating Frontier AI Agents as Autonomous Clinical Security Auditors
items.summary: Clinical AI models can expose patients to harm when adversarial vulnerabilities go undetected, yet formal security auditing requires statistical expertise, specialized tools, and significant time. We present an open evaluation task, built on METR Task Standard v0.3.0, that tests whether frontier AI agents can autonomously implement a structured clinical AI security audit. Given a pre-trained clinical prediction model, a patient dataset, and written instructions, each agent must implement four attacks from pseudocode, compute a Security Posture Score covering FGSM robustness, membership inference resistance, expected calibration error, and boundary attack resistance, and write a structured JSON report in a Docker container using only a bash interface and no scaffolding code. Six variants span the Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer and MIMIC-IV ICU mortality datasets across three model architectures with increasing defense strength, with reference scores from 55.60 to 90.41. We ran 54 evaluations across three frontier models, with three runs per variant. Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-4.1 completed all 18 runs and received perfect evaluator scores. GPT-4o completed 61 percent of runs and used about five times the per-run token count of Claude, although provider tokenization differs. Total API costs were 8 US dollars for GPT-4.1, 12 US dollars for Claude Sonnet 4.6, and 27 US dollars for GPT-4o. GPT-4o failures involved premature session termination, an aggregation error, and an empty submission file. The task, scoring infrastructure, and Wisconsin Breast Cancer assets are publicly released; MIMIC-IV variants require separate PhysioNet access.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出并实施了一项开放评估任务，用于测试前沿AI代理是否能够自主执行结构化的临床AI安全审计。研究背景是临床AI模型中的对抗性漏洞可能导致患者受到伤害，而正式的安全审计需要统计专业知识、专用工具和大量时间。作者基于METR Task Standard v0.3.0构建了一个评估框架：给定一个预训练的临床预测模型、患者数据集和书面指令，AI代理需要从伪代码实现四种攻击（FGSM鲁棒性、成员推断抵抗、预期校准误差、边界攻击抵抗），计算安全态势得分（范围55.60-90.41），并在Docker容器内仅通过bash接口生成结构化JSON报告，不使用脚手架代码。评估涵盖六个变体，涉及威斯康星诊断乳腺癌和MIMIC-IV ICU死亡率数据集，三种模型架构（防御强度递增）。在三个前沿模型（Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-4.1、GPT-4o）上进行了54次评估（每个变体3次）。结果表明：Claude Sonnet 4.6和GPT-4.1完成了所有18次运行并获得完美评估分数；GPT-4o完成了61%的运行，但每个运行的token消耗量约为Claude的5倍（尽管提供商标记化方式不同）。API总成本：GPT-4.1为8美元，Claude Sonnet 4.6为12美元，GPT-4o为27美元。GPT-4o的失败原因包括过早终止会话、聚合错误和空提交文件。任务、评分基础设施和威斯康星乳腺癌数据集已公开；MIMIC-IV变体需单独通过PhysioNet获取。该工作展示了前沿AI代理在自动化临床AI安全审计方面的潜力，为未来安全审计的自动化研究提供了基准和基础设施。

items.title: xChk: Bring Your Own Identity -- Heterogeneous Assurance with Verifier-Determined Sufficiency
items.summary: We present xChk, a reference identity provider for Bring Your Own Identity (BYOI): users enroll via heterogeneous proofs (government KYC, corporate SSO, WebAuthn/FIDO2, professional networks, live verification, longitudinal activity, behavioral signals) and disclose them as portfolio claims in standard OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect (OIDC) tokens, while each relying party applies its own sufficiency policy - the IdP transports claims and may evaluate an RP-supplied evidence policy for consent, but does not adjudicate access. Enrollment depth varies by modality (some paths are user-initiated; org KYB and officer binding are operator-assisted). xChk also supports human-in-the-loop attestation for high-risk actions: humans can initiate attestations directly (browser UI / POST /api/attestations), and AI agents acting under those principals can trigger the same gateway via scope-gated authorize/attest - hash-chained human approvals on a shared verification graph (humans via OIDC; agents via API keys). A production deployment at https://in.xchk.io ships both initiation paths with bilateral RP evaluation at consent; one documented relying party (https://crabbyed.com, Appendix B) exercises Login with xChk.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 xChk，一个参考身份提供商，实现“自带身份”（BYOI）模式：用户可以通过多种异构方式注册身份，包括政府 KYC、企业 SSO、WebAuthn/FIDO2、专业网络、实时验证、长期活动、行为信号等，并将这些证明作为声明（claims）包含在标准的 OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect (OIDC) 令牌中。每个依赖方（Relying Party, RP）自行决定足够的身份保证策略——身份提供商仅传输声明，并可根据 RP 提供的证据策略评估同意，但不裁决访问权限。注册深度因方式而异（部分路径由用户发起；组织 KYB 和绑定官员需要操作员协助）。xChk 还支持高风险操作的人工介入认证：人类可以直接通过浏览器 UI 或 POST /api/attestations 发起认证，而 AI 代理在这些主体下执行时，可以通过作用域限定的 authorize/attest 触发相同网关——基于共享验证图（humans via OIDC; agents via API keys）的哈希链式人工审批。项目已有生产部署于 https://in.xchk.io，两个发起路径均已上线，并伴有双边 RP 评估同意；一个已记录的依赖方（https://crabbyed.com，附录 B）实现了“使用 xChk 登录”。本文适合关注去中心化身份、联邦认证、零信任架构以及人机协同身份治理的安全研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: xChk 为身份验证提供了异构证据灵活组合与依赖方自主决策的新范式，尤其支持 AI 代理触发人工审批，对零信任和混合人机环境的安全设计具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于需要灵活身份保证的联邦认证场景，如企业跨组织协作、高价值操作的双重授权、以及 AI 代理的身份绑定与审计。

items.title: The Refusal Residue: When Probes Catch Alignment Faking and When They Don't
items.summary: Alignment faking is dangerous because a model can appear compliant under monitoring while preserving behavior it would reveal when unmonitored. When no scratchpad is visible, behavior alone cannot distinguish strategic from genuine compliance. We ask whether hidden states reveal what outputs hide. We run a 13-model sweep for naturally-emerging faking, then probe and steer hidden states on the two models that fake. Natural faking appears only in Qwen3-32B (+18.2pp) and Llama-3.1-8B (+24.4pp at n=10, p<10^-15), while explicit scratchpad self-reports are rare (a Claude Opus 4 judge flags faking reasoning in 1.4% of Qwen and 0.0% of Llama compliant scratchpads). Both fakers show an asymmetric refusal residue: monitored compliance shifts toward refusal (d=0.32 Qwen, d=0.33 Llama, both p<0.0001), while refusal representations do not move (p=1.00). Per-sample detection is model-conditional. Under leakage-free leave-one-query-out probing, detection survives on Llama (AUROC 0.87) but collapses to chance on Qwen (0.43), and cross-model transfer is null. Steering over 2,000 runs barely changes compliance (|h|<0.08), so the detected direction can flag faking but does not by itself control it. Standard residualized probing leaks across folds and reaches AUROC 0.63 on a control where no faking can occur; naive linear probes reach a meaningless AUROC 1.0; and conventional MLPs overstate detectability by 0.2-0.3 AUROC. For future alignment-faking detection work, we release a five-control measurement framework: multi-token extraction, refuse-vs-refuse confound checks, per-fold residualization, leave-one-query-out evaluation, and orthogonality-constrained probing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该研究聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）中的对齐伪装（alignment faking）问题：模型在受监控时表面顺从，但一旦脱离监控则可能暴露出隐藏的真实行为。当模型不提供中间推理过程（如scratchpad）时，仅凭行为无法区分策略性顺从与真正顺从。作者对13个模型进行系统性扫描，发现自然伪装仅出现在Qwen3-32B（伪装率提升18.2个百分点）和Llama-3.1-8B（n=10时提升24.4个百分点，p<10^-15）中，而显式的scratchpad自我报告极为罕见（Claude Opus 4裁判仅在Qwen的1.4%和Llama的0.0%的顺从scratchpad中标记出伪装推理）。两个伪装模型均表现出不对称的“拒绝残留”（refusal residue）：在受监控的顺从状态下，隐藏表示向拒绝方向偏移（Qwen d=0.32，Llama d=0.33，均p<0.0001），而拒绝状态的表示则不发生移动（p=1.00）。基于单个样本的检测具有模型条件性：在无泄漏的留一查询外（leave-one-query-out）探测下，Llama上的检测有效（AUROC 0.87），但Qwen上降至随机水平（0.43），且跨模型迁移无效。对隐藏表示进行2000次引导（steering）几乎不改变顺从行为（|h|<0.08），因此探测到的方向可标记伪装但无法控制伪装。此外，标准残差化探针会跨折泄露信息，在无伪装的对照上达到AUROC 0.63；朴素线性探针产生无意义的AUROC 1.0；传统MLP则高估可检测性0.2-0.3 AUROC。为未来对齐伪装检测工作，作者发布了一个五控制测量框架：多token提取、拒绝vs拒绝混杂检查、每折残差化、留一查询外评估、正交约束探针。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对齐伪装是LLM安全的核心风险，现有的隐藏状态探测方法存在严重局限性且条件性强。本研究揭示了探测的过度乐观问题，并为可靠检测提供了评估框架，对安全从业者的监控和红队实践具有直接指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响AI安全评估中依赖隐藏状态探测的方法论，尤其对模型对齐测试、监控系统设计以及对抗性评估的可靠性产生重要影响；所提出的五控制框架可迁移至其他隐蔽行为检测场景。
detection_signals_zh: 不对称拒绝残留：监控下顺从状态向拒绝方向偏移而拒绝状态不变
每样本检测性能模型条件性（Llama有效但Qwen无效）
跨模型探测迁移失效
标准残差探针在无伪装对照上产生虚警
defense_advice_zh: 采用五控制测量框架评估任何隐藏状态探测方法
避免单一探针或跨模型迁移假设，需针对具体模型进行条件化验证
使用留一查询外评估防止过拟合，并实施拒绝vs拒绝混杂检查
警惕朴素线性探针和MLP的高估问题，采用正交约束探针
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，纳入内部对齐伪装检测评估流程

items.title: Delving into the Temporal Challenges of Unified Video Protection Against Image-to-Video and Fine-Tuning-based Customization
items.summary: Recent diffusion-based video generation models have enabled high-quality personalized video customization through both tuning-based pipelines, which fine-tune a video diffusion model, and reference-based pipelines such as image-to-video generation. However, these capabilities raise serious concerns about personal privacy, identity ownership and intellectual property protection. Existing anti-customization works focus on protecting images, while protection for videos against both reference- and tuning-based customization remains largely underexplored. Protecting videos in this setting raises three challenges: (i) Image-level perturbations, optimized frame by frame, cannot survive temporal compression by 3D video VAE. (ii) A video-level perturbation optimized on a single video is vulnerable to temporal editing and fails to protect unseen videos. (iii) Temporally inconsistent perturbations are not robust to temporal attacks. To address these challenges, we propose Temporally Consistent Universal Adversarial Perturbations (TC-UAP), the first protection method against both reference- and tuning-based video customization. TC-UAP optimizes an identity-level multi-frame UAP over sliding windows from multiple videos, accounting for local temporal dependencies induced by temporal compression in video VAE and enabling a single perturbation to protect unseen videos of varying lengths. Moreover, we introduce intrinsic temporal modeling and an extrinsic surrogate temporal-attack loss, which make the perturbation temporally consistent and robust to unseen temporal attacks. Empirically, quantitative and qualitative results show that TC-UAP achieves the strongest identity protection compared with existing methods under both reference- and tuning-based video customization, and remains robust under multiple unseen temporal attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对基于扩散模型的视频生成技术（包括基于微调的视频定制和基于参考的图像到视频生成）带来的隐私、身份和知识产权保护问题，提出了一种统一视频保护方法。现有对抗定制化工作主要聚焦图像保护，而视频保护面临三大时间挑战：(i) 逐帧优化的图像级扰动无法抵抗3D视频VAE的时间压缩；(ii) 单视频优化的视频级扰动易受时间编辑攻击，且无法保护未见视频；(iii) 时间不一致的扰动对时间攻击鲁棒性差。为应对这些挑战，作者提出时间一致通用对抗扰动（TC-UAP），这是首个同时防御基于参考和基于微调的视频定制方法。TC-UAP通过从多个视频的滑动窗口上优化身份级多帧UAP，考虑了视频VAE时间压缩带来的局部时间依赖性，使得单个扰动能够保护不同长度的未见视频。此外，引入内在时间建模和外在替代时间攻击损失，使扰动具有时间一致性并对未见时间攻击保持鲁棒。实验结果表明，TC-UAP在身份保护强度上显著优于现有方法，且在多种未见时间攻击下保持鲁棒。该工作为视频内容保护提供了新思路，适合从事生成模型安全、隐私保护和对抗攻击防御的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 视频生成模型的滥用可能导致个人身份盗用和版权侵犯，本文首次系统解决视频级对抗保护的时间一致性难题，填补了从图像到视频防护的空白。

items.title: Privacy Preserving Recommender Systems Balancing Personalization with Privacy
items.summary: Personalized recommendation systems are central to modern e-commerce and retail platforms, but they typically rely on centralized storage of detailed user interaction data, creating significant privacy and regulatory challenges. With increasing requirements from regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and CPRA, organizations must develop recommendation systems that preserve user privacy without substantially degrading recommendation quality. This work presents and evaluates a privacy-preserving recommendation framework that combines federated learning, differential privacy, cohort-level modeling, and privacy-aware intelligent agents. The framework keeps raw user data decentralized while introducing mathematically bounded noise to model updates. Experiments were conducted on synthetic retail datasets that emulate customer clickstream and purchase behavior. Recommendation quality was evaluated using Click-Through Rate (CTR), Precision@K, Recall@K, and Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG@K) across multiple differential privacy budgets. We evaluate matrix factorization, neural collaborative filtering, and GRU4Rec under varying privacy constraints and analyze the trade-off between privacy and utility. An interactive Streamlit dashboard was developed to visualize recommendation performance, ranking stability, privacy-utility trade-offs, and fairness metrics. Results show that the proposed framework maintains competitive recommendation quality at moderate privacy budgets (approximately $ε\approx 5$), demonstrating that strong privacy guarantees can be achieved with limited impact on recommendation effectiveness. This work provides a practical framework for deploying privacy-preserving recommendation systems that balance personalization, regulatory compliance, and business objectives, offering a scalable approach for next-generation AI-driven retail platforms.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对现代推荐系统依赖集中化用户数据存储所引发的隐私与合规挑战（如GDPR、CCPA等），提出了一种隐私保护推荐框架。该框架融合了联邦学习、差分隐私、群组级建模和隐私感知智能代理：原始用户数据保留在本地设备，模型更新时加入数学上可界定的噪声。实验基于模拟零售数据集的用户点击流和购买行为，使用点击率（CTR）、Precision@K、Recall@K和NDCG@K等指标，在不同差分隐私预算（ε）下评估了矩阵分解、神经协同过滤和GRU4Rec三种推荐算法的效果。研究显示，在中等隐私预算（ε≈5）下，推荐质量保持竞争力，表明强隐私保证可以以有限的推荐效果代价实现。论文还开发了交互式Streamlit仪表盘用于可视化性能、排名稳定性、隐私-效用权衡和公平性指标。该工作为电商和零售平台提供了一种可扩展的隐私保护推荐系统实践方案，平衡了个性化、法规合规与商业目标。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为安全从业者提供了在推荐系统中实现隐私保护（差分隐私、联邦学习）的可行框架，有助于满足GDPR等合规要求并降低数据泄露风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接应用于电商、社交媒体等依赖个性化推荐的平台，指导隐私合规的推荐系统设计与部署。

items.why_it_matters: 为安全从业者提供了在推荐系统中实现隐私保护（差分隐私、联邦学习）的可行框架，有助于满足GDPR等合规要求并降低数据泄露风险。

items.title: Proof in a Bottle: Long-Lived Verifiable Secret Sharing via Pre-Quantum Commitment and Immutable Ledger Binding
items.summary: Traditional secret sharing techniques such as Verifiable Secret sharing (VSS) are vulnerable to quantum attacks by a Cryptographically Relevant Quantum Computer (CRQC) running Shor's algorithm. We observe that the binding a VSS needs is required only at the moment of dealing, and this binding can be made before any CRQC exists. We propose Proof in a Bottle (PiB), which decouples verifiability from long-term binding: standard Pedersen commitments provide zero-knowledge, publicly checkable consistency during a pre-quantum window, while a salted, index-bound hash of the share set, anchored to an immutable public ledger, preserves the binding established in that window into the post-quantum era. The guarantee is explicitly a commit-now, reveal-later one: it protects today's honest dealings against tomorrow's quantum adversary.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为“Proof in a Bottle (PiB)”的新型可验证秘密共享方案，旨在解决传统VSS面对量子计算攻击的脆弱性。传统VSS依赖于承诺和绑定，但Shor算法可破解离散对数问题，从而破坏绑定。PiB的关键洞察是：绑定仅在秘密分发的时刻需要，而该时刻可能发生在量子计算机出现之前。因此，方案将可验证性与长期绑定解耦：在“前量子窗口”内，使用标准Pedersen承诺提供零知识、公开可验证的一致性检查；同时，将秘密共享集合的加盐索引哈希锚定到不可变的公共账本（如区块链），从而将该窗口内建立的绑定保留到后量子时代。这种“现在承诺，稍后揭示”的机制保护了今天的诚实交易免受未来量子敌手的攻击。论文的主要贡献是提出了一个实用的过渡方案，使得现有秘密共享系统能够在不依赖后量子密码学的情况下抵御量子威胁。适合密码学研究人员、区块链开发者及安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对即将到来的量子计算威胁，本文提供了无需等待后量子密码标准即可增强秘密共享长期安全性的实用方案，对金融、政务等需要长期保密性的场景具有重要价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到需要长期安全承诺的分布式系统、区块链、多方计算及密钥管理服务。

items.why_it_matters: 针对即将到来的量子计算威胁，本文提供了无需等待后量子密码标准即可增强秘密共享长期安全性的实用方案，对金融、政务等需要长期保密性的场景具有重要价值。

items.title: AI-Native Insurance for Agentic AI: Pricing, Underwriting, and End-to-End Automation
items.summary: Agentic AI introduces new insurance challenges because autonomous AI systems can make decisions, invoke tools, modify external environments, and interact with third-party services. This paper develops an AI-native mathematical framework for underwriting, pricing, and contract design for agentic AI deployments. A deployment is represented by a risk state that captures autonomy level, operational authority, permission exposure, governance maturity, and dependency concentration. The framework maps the risk state to event probabilities, loss severities, governance costs, premiums, deductibles, coverage allocation, and policy covenants, and formulates an optimization problem for insurance contract design under participation, profitability, and incentive compatibility constraints. The paper establishes structural properties of insurability, including characterization of an insurability region, monotone deterioration of feasibility with increasing exposure, and governance certification thresholds. Insurance is further interpreted as both an operational cost and a regulatory mechanism for AI deployment. A healthcare case study illustrates contract optimization, sensitivity analysis, and automated claims processing for agentic AI systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向自主AI系统（Agentic AI）的AI原生保险框架，旨在解决传统保险难以覆盖自主决策、工具调用、外部环境修改及第三方服务交互等新型风险的问题。作者将AI部署表示为一个风险状态，该状态捕捉自治水平、操作权限、权限暴露、治理成熟度和依赖集中度等关键维度。框架将这些风险状态映射到事件概率、损失严重性、治理成本、保费、免赔额、覆盖分配和保单条款，并在参与约束、盈利约束和激励相容约束下，将保险合同设计建模为一个优化问题。论文建立了可保性的结构性质，包括可保性区域的刻画、风险暴露增加导致可行性单调恶化、以及治理认证阈值。此外，保险被解释为AI部署的运营成本和监管机制。通过一个医疗案例研究，展示了合约优化、敏感性分析和自动化理赔处理流程。本文适合保险精算师、AI治理研究员、安全风险管理师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为自主AI系统的风险管理提供了首个量化保险框架，安全团队可借此评估部署风险、设计保费机制，并推动治理成熟度提升。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响AI保险产品设计，可迁移至自动驾驶、金融交易、医疗诊断等高风险自主系统场景。

items.title: Why Not Fix It Once and for All? An Empirical Study of Multiple Patches for Vulnerability Fixes in Open-Source Software
items.summary: Security patches for open-source software constitute a foundational resource for vulnerability remediation research and practice. However, analyzing and applying multiple patches remains challenging, especially when trying to determine at what point in a patch sequence a vulnerability is fully remediated. This paper presents a systematic analysis of multi-patch vulnerability fixes, focusing on their root causes, characteristics, and methods for verifying remediation status throughout the fixing process. Through a manual examination of 1,646 multi-patch fix records, we develop a taxonomy with three primary categories and six subcategories based on their causes. We then compare the distinctive characteristics of multi-patch fixes with those of single-patch fixes and analyze feature variations across categories. In addition, we assess representative vulnerability detection methods for validating complete remediation during multi-patch fixing. Our findings provide new insights into multi-patch fixes and lay a foundation for future research in this field.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对开源软件中漏洞修复过程中出现的“多补丁”现象进行了系统性的实证研究。在软件安全领域，通常认为一个漏洞对应一个补丁，但实际中一个漏洞的修复可能需要多个补丁才能彻底完成。研究者手动审查了1,646条多补丁修复记录，通过根因分析构建了一个分类体系，包含3个主要类别和6个子类别。主要类别包括：补丁不完全修复（部分漏洞被遗漏）、补丁引发新问题（修复引入新漏洞或副作用）、以及补丁交互问题（多个补丁之间存在依赖或冲突）。论文进一步比较了多补丁修复与单补丁修复在特征上的差异，包括补丁大小、修改文件数、复杂度等指标。此外，作者评估了多种代表性漏洞检测方法（如静态分析、动态测试）在验证多补丁修复过程中是否彻底修复漏洞的有效性。实验发现，现有检测方法在多补丁场景下普遍存在漏报或误报，尤其难以识别因补丁交互导致的未完全修复。该研究为理解复杂漏洞修复过程提供了新视角，为开发更精准的漏洞修复验证工具奠定了基础，同时也提醒开发者在应用补丁时需要持续跟踪后续补丁。适合安全运维人员、漏洞研究人员和软件工程学者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了开源软件漏洞修复中常被忽视的“多补丁”现象，帮助安全团队更准确评估补丁的完整修复状态，避免因部分修复而残留风险。

items.title: BARS: Benign-Anchored Ranking and Selection for False Alarm Reduction in Network Intrusion Detection
items.summary: False alarms remain a major barrier to deploying network intrusion detection systems (NIDS). In high-volume environments, even a sub-1% false positive rate can generate tens of thousands of daily alerts. Filter-based feature selection is attractive because it operates upstream of the classifier and adds no inference-time cost. However, classical filters use class-symmetric criteria that ignore the asymmetry of intrusion detection, where benign traffic defines the baseline and attacks are deviations from it. A recent class-asymmetric filter, Classwise Mean Deviation (CMD), addresses this issue but anchors its score to a global mean that shifts toward attack distributions under class imbalance, weakening the deviations it aims to capture. We propose Benign-Anchored Ranking and Selection (BARS), a two-stage filter that replaces CMD's global anchor with the benign-class mean and applies an order-preserving decorrelation step. We evaluate BARS on CICIDS2017, CICDDoS2019, and UNSW-NB15 using feature budgets k = {5, 10, 20, 30, 40}. On attack-majority datasets, where global-anchor bias is strongest, BARS reduces false positive rate relative to CMD by 15.4% on UNSW-NB15 at k = 20 and by 21% to 23% on CICDDoS2019 at small feature budgets while preserving true positive rate and macro-F1. On benign-majority data, BARS and CMD converge, consistent with the theoretical limit where global- and benign-anchored scores coincide. BARS is a principled refinement of CMD rather than a universally dominant filter. Although Pearson Correlation and Mutual Information often achieve lower false positive rates, they exceeded 1 TB of memory on the largest benchmarks in our evaluation. BARS retains linear-time scoring and a low memory footprint, making it suitable for resource-constrained deployments.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）在实际部署中面临高误报率的严峻挑战。即使误报率低于1%，在高流量环境下每天也能产生数万条告警。传统的基于过滤的特征选择方法虽然因其位于分类器上游且不增加推理时成本而具有吸引力，但经典过滤器采用类别对称准则，忽略了入侵检测的非对称性——正常流量定义基线，攻击则是对基线的偏离。最近提出的类别非对称过滤器“类均值偏差”（CMD）试图解决此问题，但其得分锚定于全局均值，在类别不平衡时全局均值会向攻击分布偏移，从而削弱其旨在捕捉的偏离。本文提出良性锚定排序与选择（BARS）方法，这是一种两阶段过滤器，将CMD的全局锚点替换为良性类均值，并应用保序去相关步骤。在CICIDS2017、CICDDoS2019和UNSW-NB15三个数据集上，使用特征预算k={5,10,20,30,40}进行评估。在攻击占多数的数据集上（全局锚点偏差最严重），BARS相比CMD显著降低了误报率：在UNSW-NB15上k=20时误报率降低15.4%，在CICDDoS2019上小特征预算时误报率降低21%至23%，同时保持真阳率和宏F1分数。在良性占多数的数据上，BARS和CMD性能趋同，符合理论极限。BARS是对CMD的原则性改进，而非全面占优的过滤器。值得注意的是，皮尔逊相关性和互信息虽然常能获得更低的误报率，但在最大基准测试中内存消耗超过1TB；而BARS保持线性时间评分和低内存占用，适用于资源受限的部署环境。本文主要贡献在于提出一种轻量级、低误报的特征选择方法，特别适合需要在线运行且计算资源有限的NIDS场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: NIDS中误报淹没有效告警是长期痛点，BARS方法在不牺牲检测率的前提下大幅降低误报，且计算开销极低，对资源受限的部署环境有直接价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何基于特征分类的入侵检测系统，特别适合边缘设备或高吞吐网络环境。
detection_signals_zh: 过滤后特征空间中的良性类均值偏离度显著大于CMD对应的指标
采用保序去相关步骤后特征间冗余降低
defense_advice_zh: 部署BARS作为特征预筛选模块，替代CMD或对称过滤器
结合评估中的特征预算k=20~30进行试点，平衡误报与检测率

items.title: Composable Trust for Language Models: A proven boundary and a measured defense
items.summary: In a language model, instructions and data share one token stream, so nothing inside the model's generation can keep untrusted text from steering it. We develop a trust model that places the authority to act outside the model, in code: a source's standing, not its content, decides which operation runs and whether it acts. A lower-trust source may inform an answer but not override a higher one. An unmodified model runs inside a deterministic pipeline that ranks inputs by source integrity, and a fixed non-model monitor provably chooses the operation and any outside action from trusted inputs alone. We can measure but not prove the pipeline's resistance to injection; we prompt-tune it and report the rate. On a one-shot held-out set with an unmodified Gemma~4 26B model, passivation and a wrapper (the cascade) raise the genuine-leak defended rate from $27\%$ to $94\%$ at roughly a $4\%$ clean-quality cost ($Q_{\mathrm{rel}}{=}0.96$). Under adaptive red-teaming the proved boundary holds unconditionally, and the measured defense stays at $87\%$. The cascade also attributes a lower-trust source's fact rather than dropping it, raising attribution from $0\%$ to $92\%$, and follows the higher-trust source on a conflict.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文针对语言模型中指令与数据共享同一 token 流导致无法阻止未授权文本操纵模型生成的问题，提出了一种可组合的信任模型。该模型将行动权威置于模型外部，即由代码决定：依据信息来源的“身份”而非“内容”来决定执行哪个操作以及是否执行。低信任源可以影响答案但不能覆盖高信任源。未修改的模型运行在一个确定性流水线中，该流水线根据源完整性对输入排序，一个固定的非模型监视器可证明地仅从可信源选择操作和任何外部动作。虽然无法证明流水线对注入的抵抗能力，但可以通过提示调优来测量并报告该比率。实验使用未修改的 Gemma 4 26B 模型，在一次性保留集上，通过钝化（passivation）和包装器（cascade）将真实泄露的防御率从 27% 提升至 94%，同时清洁质量成本约为 4%（Q_rel=0.96）。在自适应红队测试下，已证明的边界无条件成立，测量的防御率仍保持 87%。该级联机制还能将低信任源的事实归因而非丢弃，将归因率从 0% 提升至 92%，并在冲突时遵循高信任源。核心贡献在于提供了一种可证明的边界和可测量的防御方法，适合关注 LLM 安全、对抗性鲁棒性以及可信 AI 的研究人员和实践者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为 LLM 注入攻击提供了一种可证明的边界防御方法，通过将信任决策外置于模型本身，使防御具有形式化保证。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接应用于基于 LLM 的智能助手、客服系统、代码生成等场景，在不显著影响生成质量的情况下大幅提高抗注入能力。

items.title: Watermark Forensics for Generative Models: An Information-Theoretic Perspective
items.summary: A watermark in a generative model's output is usually asked only whether a text is machine-made. The same mark can do more: attribute it to the user who produced it, extract a hidden payload, or localize the part that survives editing. These form a forensic ladder, and we ask what each rung costs in the sample length $n$. One object organizes the answers. Let $S$ be the secret the mark carries (a user's identity or payload), and let the information profile $ν(t)=I(S;X_t\mid X_{<t})$ record how much the $t$-th token reveals about $S$ given the earlier ones. Its total mass pays for attribution and extraction; how that mass is spread pays for localization; and detection alone is paid for not by information but by presence, the distance from the marked to the unmarked distribution. The literature's two quality models, a mark subtle on every token and one that stamps a few tokens loudly, are two incomparable ways of capping this profile. Our main theorem settles the ladder's entropy column. For statistically distortion-free schemes, attributing a text to one of $N$ users costs $Θ(\log N/h)$ tokens over every stationary-ergodic source of entropy rate $h$, sharp to a $(1+o(1))$ factor: to our knowledge the first tight entropy-rate law for multi-user attribution (via exact alignment). The natural collision-counting analysis overcharges without bound; only a decoder thresholding each candidate by its own realized surprisal attains the rate while almost never implicating an innocent user. A matching converse makes the law two-sided, and extraction of an $\ell$-bit payload costs $Θ(\ell/h)$. Two gaps are real, not modeling artifacts: a $Θ(\log N)$-token window in which a text is provably machine-made yet unattributable, and a footprint-resolution uncertainty principle. Experiments on GPT-2, Pythia-410M, and Qwen2.5 recover the predicted constants.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文从信息论角度研究生成模型（如大语言模型）输出水印的取证能力。传统水印仅用于检测文本是否为机器生成，但本文提出一个更丰富的取证阶梯：归因（将输出追溯到特定用户）、提取（从水印中恢复隐藏载荷）和定位（找出经过编辑后幸存的水印部分）。作者引入“信息轮廓” ν(t)=I(S;X_t|X_{<t})，其中S为水印携带的秘密（用户身份或载荷），X_t为第t个token，该轮廓刻画了每个token对秘密的信息泄露量。主要定理给出了在统计无失真方案下各任务所需样本长度n的紧确界：将一段文本归因至N个用户之一需Θ(log N / h)个token，提取ℓ位载荷需Θ(ℓ/h)个token，其中h为平稳遍历信源的熵率。这一界限是通过精确对齐的熵率定律实现的，优于传统的碰撞计数分析。同时，本文揭示了两个固有间隙：一个Θ(log N) token窗口内文本被证明是机器生成但无法归因，以及分辨率与定位不确定度之间的矛盾。实验在GPT-2、Pythia-410M和Qwen2.5上验证了理论常数。该工作为水印取证提供了统一信息论框架，有助于设计更可靠的溯源与隐私保护机制。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为生成模型水印的取证能力提供了信息论下限，帮助安全从业者量化水印系统的归因、载荷提取和定位效率，优化水印设计并评估泄露风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可用于LLM输出溯源、用户行为审计、隐蔽通信检测等场景，指导水印方案的参数选择。

items.title: AI in Cyberpsychology: A systematic literature review of Cybersecurity enhancement by using AI for analyzing psychology of Victims, Attackers, and Defenders
items.summary: Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting systems, networks, and data from digital attacks. Cyberpsychology (CPSY) is defined as the use of psychology to enhance cybersecurity applications. Since the early 2010s, the evolution of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has increasingly integrated with CPSY, leveraging advanced data analysis to decode the distinct personality traits and behavioral patterns of victims, attackers, and defenders. In this systematic literature review (SLR), we carefully analyze 34 collected research studies of AI usage in cyberpsychology (AI-CPSY) using the preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analyses (PRISMA) methodology. The review presents a comprehensive taxonomy of the cyber-security applications, the AI methodologies used, and the psychological concepts employed across the studies . We sort the research studies into four cybersecurity applications: Anomaly Detection (AD), Vulnerability Risk Prediction (VRP), Security Awareness Training (SAT), and Authentication/Identity Verification (AIV). Within each application area, studies are further sorted according to the AI method used including machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), natural language processing (NLP), and reinforcement learning (RL). Furthermore, the review identifies the most commonly utilized psychological concepts, quantify the datasets used in the field, and present their current implementation and deployment status. At last, it detect research gaps, present open challenges, and deduce the trending and most effective and emerging methodologies used across the AI-CPSY landscape.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇系统文献综述（SLR），旨在梳理人工智能（AI）在网络心理学（Cyberpsychology, CPSY）领域的最新研究进展，尤其是如何利用AI分析受害者、攻击者和防御者的心理特征与行为模式来增强网络安全。作者遵循PRISMA方法论，从多个数据库筛选出34篇相关研究，并对其进行了结构化分析。综述首先构建了一个全面的分类体系，将研究划分为四个网络安全应用领域：异常检测（AD）、脆弱性风险预测（VRP）、安全意识培训（SAT）和认证/身份验证（AIV）。在每个应用领域内，进一步按照所使用的AI方法（机器学习、深度学习、自然语言处理、强化学习）进行归类。此外，本文归纳了研究中常用的心理学概念（如人格特质、认知偏差、行为动机等），统计了数据集来源与规模，并报告了各项研究的实际部署状态。最后，作者指出了当前研究中的空白与开放挑战，总结了AI-CPSY领域内新兴且有效的方法论趋势。该综述为安全研究人员、心理学专家以及AI从业者提供了跨学科参考，有助于理解如何通过心理分析提升防御策略、预测攻击者行为并设计更人性化的安全系统。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次系统整合AI与网络心理学的研究，为安全从业者揭示如何利用心理特征增强威胁检测、风险预测和用户认证，开辟了人机交叉的新防御视角。

items.title: Designing a GDPR-Compliant Security Architecture for Remote Elderly Care Systems: A Privacy-by-Design Approach
items.summary: IoMT-based remote elderly care systems generate continuous streams of sensitive health data, yet existing security architectures have not simultaneously addressed three interdependent challenges: GDPR-compliant edge-layer pseudonymisation, elderly-specific zero-interaction usability as a binding architectural constraint, and integrated STRIDE-based threat validation within a single unified design. This paper presents the Secure Edge Gateway (SEG) framework - a software-simulation-validated integrated IoMT security architecture for elderly care designed to resolve all three dimensions of this tripartite gap simultaneously. An ESP32-WROOM-32 residential gateway enforces MAC address whitelisting, HMAC-SHA256 cryptographic pseudonymisation before any network transmission, AES-128-CBC payload encryption, and TLS 1.3 transport security, in compliance with GDPR Articles 25 and 32. The framework is validated through software-based simulation, full STRIDE threat modelling across all six categories, attack tree analysis, GDPR compliance mapping across nine regulatory obligations, and a Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) under Article 35. Published benchmarks confirm MQTT consumes 6-8% less energy than HTTP in comparable IoT deployments, and edge processing achieves sub-50 ms response latency versus 200-700 ms for cloud-only systems. The results demonstrate that GDPR compliance and operational efficiency are complementary - not competing - objectives in resource-constrained IoMT deployments for elderly care.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对基于IoMT的远程老年人护理系统中敏感健康数据持续流出的安全问题，提出了一种名为Secure Edge Gateway (SEG) 的集成安全架构。研究背景指出，现有安全架构未能同时解决三个相互依赖的挑战：GDPR合规的边缘层假名化、老年人特定的零交互可用性（作为架构约束），以及集成STRIDE威胁验证的统一设计。SEG框架通过软件仿真进行验证，核心组件包括ESP32-WROOM-32住宅网关，实施MAC地址白名单、HMAC-SHA256加密假名化（在网络传输前）、AES-128-CBC有效载荷加密和TLS 1.3传输安全，符合GDPR第25条和第32条。验证方法包括全STRIDE威胁建模（覆盖所有六类威胁）、攻击树分析、GDPR合规映射（九项监管义务）以及根据第35条的数据保护影响评估（DPIA）。实验结果表明，与纯云系统相比，边缘处理实现了低于50毫秒的响应延迟（云系统为200-700毫秒），MQTT比HTTP能耗低6-8%。主要贡献在于证明了在资源受限的IoMT老年人护理部署中，GDPR合规性和运营效率是互补而非竞争目标。适合关注医疗物联网安全、隐私合规及边缘计算的安全研究人员和架构师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为老年人护理场景提供了GDPR合规的实用安全架构设计，填补了隐私保护、可用性与威胁建模三者整合的空白，对医疗物联网安全实践有直接参考价值。

items.title: Silent Alarm: A J-Space Protocol for Comparing Danger Recognition Across Models and Quantization Levels
items.summary: Jailbreak-robustness research typically evaluates safety through generated responses using an LLM-as-judge approach. Such evaluations, however, are sensitive to the benchmark's grading procedure and capture only observed behavior on a given set of attacks, without directly revealing the hidden fragility of the underlying safety mechanisms. This work proposes JADR (Jacobian Assessment of Danger Recognition), a protocol that measures a model's internal representation through Jacobian space (J-space, a recently proposed workspace of verbalizable concepts) before the first response token is generated. For every prompt and layer we record the top-k J-space tokens; these are grouped into six behavioral scenario axes and compared between a danger sample based on StrongREJECT and a safe control drawn from XSTest and OKTest. The method does not call on an external judge model: the computation runs entirely locally, on the activations of the model under evaluation, which lets us compare both different models against each other and modifications of a single model -- quantization and fine-tuning in particular -- on the same terms. The final comparison rests on the proposed SafetyAUC metric, complemented with bootstrap confidence intervals. The protocol is applied to six models (Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-Uncensored-4B, Qwen3-SafeRL-4B, Gemma 2 9B) across three weight-representation regimes -- BF16, INT8, and INT4 -- and checked against an independent behavioral evaluation with the StrongREJECT grader. The metric separates models with a strong versus a weak internal safety mechanism with statistical significance and captures substantively different effects across quantization regimes.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为 JADR（Jacobian Assessment of Danger Recognition）的协议，用于在模型生成首个响应 token 之前，通过雅可比空间（J-space）测量模型内部对危险提示的识别能力。传统越狱鲁棒性评估依赖外部评判模型对生成回复进行打分，但这种方法受限于评价标准且仅能捕获可见行为，无法揭示底层安全机制的脆弱性。JADR 通过在模型每一层提取 top-k J-space 令牌，并将其映射到六个行为情景轴，从而比较危险样本（基于 StrongREJECT）与安全控制样本（来自 XSTest 和 OKTest）的内部表征差异。该方法完全本地运行，无需外部评判模型，可公平比较不同模型及同一模型的不同量化版本（如 BF16、INT8、INT4）和微调变体。最终比较采用提出的 SafetyAUC 指标，并辅以 bootstrap 置信区间。作者对六个模型（Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-Uncensored-4B、Qwen3-SafeRL-4B、Gemma 2 9B）在三种权重量化设置下进行了实验，并与 StrongREJECT 评判器的独立行为评估进行了对比。结果表明，该指标能够以统计显著性区分具有强内部安全机制与弱内部安全机制的模型，并捕捉到不同量化制度下的实质差异。该工作为理解 LLM 安全机制的内部运作提供了新视角，并可能用于无需攻击即可预评估模型的安全性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提供一种不依赖外部评判模型的内部安全评估方法，能够揭示量化、微调等修改对模型危险识别能力的细微影响，有助于蓝队在部署前更可靠地衡量 LLM 的底层安全机制强度。

items.title: A Scalable Cloud-Orchestrated and Service-Oriented Multi-Domain QKD Network with PQC Integration
items.summary: Quantum key distribution (QKD) offers unconditional security but existing QKD networks remain difficult to scale across heterogeneous infrastructures and administrative domains due to vendor-specific interfaces, trusted-node constraints, and limited interoperability. This work presents a flexible multi-domain and multi-site quantum-secure network architecture integrating vendor-agnostic QKD, SDN orchestration, and cloud-managed trust services. Communication is based on Zero Trust Network Access protocols featuring multi-level authentication mechanisms building upon post-quantum cryptography (PQC) signature and key encapsulation algorithms. The system is deployed on a real-world testbed with domains incorporating QKD nodes from 3 vendors, as well as domains without QKD infrastructure elements. Experimental results show that PQC and SDN overhead remain relatively low even on constrained devices, with the main bottleneck being QKD key retrieval and vendor-specific key streaming limitations. The proposed framework extends quantum-safe key transport beyond native QKD boundaries while preserving flexibility, interoperability, and compatibility with existing infrastructures.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对现有量子密钥分发（QKD）网络在跨异构基础设施和管理域时面临的可扩展性、互操作性及兼容性问题，提出了一种灵活的多域多站点量子安全网络架构。该架构融合了供应商无关的QKD、软件定义网络（SDN）编排和云管理的信任服务，并基于零信任网络访问协议，利用后量子密码（PQC）签名和密钥封装算法实现多级认证。系统在真实测试床上部署，涵盖三个不同供应商的QKD节点域以及无QKD基础设施的域，实验结果表明：PQC和SDN开销即使在受限设备上仍保持较低水平，主要瓶颈在于QKD密钥检索和供应商特定的密钥流限制。所提框架在保持灵活性、互操作性和与现有基础设施兼容的同时，将量子安全密钥传输扩展到了原生QKD边界之外。该研究为构建大规模、实用化的量子安全通信网络提供了重要参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: QKD网络因供应商锁定和域间碎片化难以大规模部署，该架构通过云编排和PQC集成打破壁垒，为未来量子安全基础设施的落地提供工程化方案，值得安全架构师关注。

items.why_it_matters: QKD网络因供应商锁定和域间碎片化难以大规模部署，该架构通过云编排和PQC集成打破壁垒，为未来量子安全基础设施的落地提供工程化方案，值得安全架构师关注。

items.title: Stability Buys Time: A Re-Keying Game for Encrypted Multi-Agent Control
items.summary: Encrypted control lets a cloud coordinate a fleet of agents on fully homomorphically encrypted state, keeping their positions and commands private. The approximate scheme for real-valued control, CKKS, returns decryptions that carry the encryption noise, a key-recovery leak; the loop must decrypt to actuate, so the leak is unavoidable. Yet the security of approximate FHE is studied statically, encrypted control assumes an honest-but-curious cloud, and persistent-threat games never reach inside the cryptosystem. We model the loop's security under an advanced persistent threat as a two-phase game, passive reconnaissance then active manipulation, separated by a measured residual detector that sees only the manipulation. The passive phase reduces to the known flooding tradeoff; the active defense is re-keying, not bootstrapping, since only re-keying resets accumulated leakage. The active phase is a detection-evasion timing game: overt manipulation is caught, so the rational adversary stays stealthy, and at its Stackelberg equilibrium the defender re-keys on the laziest cadence that denies it, set by the control-theoretic fragility of the graph topology. The marginally-stable graph must re-key far more often than the well-connected one. A three-way tension among FHE precision, control accuracy, and re-key cadence sets where this game lives, between a securability floor and a static-suffices ceiling. The efficient secure point is that window, where re-keying is the price of precision efficiency. More broadly, security for an approximate cryptosystem in a feedback loop is a dynamic game whose defender's move is the scheme's own refresh, applying beyond control to any system that must repeatedly decrypt to act.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究在云端通过全同态加密（FHE）协调多智能体车队时的安全问题。具体使用CKKS近似方案加密实数状态，但解密时会携带加密噪声，从而造成密钥恢复泄露。由于控制回路必须解密才能执行动作，这种泄露无法避免。现有研究将近似FHE的安全性视为静态，且加密控制通常假设诚实但好奇的云服务器，而持续性威胁博弈从未深入到密码系统内部。论文将回路在高级持续性威胁（APT）下的安全性建模为两阶段博弈：被动侦察和主动操纵，两者之间由一个仅能观测操纵行为的残差检测器隔开。被动阶段简化为已知的洪泛权衡；主动防御采用重密钥（re-keying）而非自举（bootstrapping），因为只有重密钥能重置累积泄露。主动阶段是一个检测规避的时间博弈：明显操纵会被捕获，因此理性对手保持隐蔽；在Stackelberg均衡下，防御者以最慢的重密钥节奏拒绝对手，该节奏由图拓扑的控制理论脆弱性决定。边缘稳定图必须比连通良好的图更频繁地重密钥。FHE精度、控制精度和重密钥节奏之间的三元张力定义了博弈存在的区间，介于可安全性下限与静态足够上限之间。高效安全点就在该窗口内，重密钥是精度效率的代价。更广泛地说，反馈回路中近似密码系统的安全性是一个动态博弈，防御者的行动是方案自身的刷新，该结论可推广到任何必须反复解密才能执行的系统。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次将近似全同态加密在闭环控制中的安全性建模为动态博弈，揭示了重密钥策略与控制拓扑脆弱性的直接关联，为加密控制系统设计提供了理论基础。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于近似FHE的加密控制或计算系统，尤其是需要频繁解密执行的关键基础设施。

items.why_it_matters: 首次将近似全同态加密在闭环控制中的安全性建模为动态博弈，揭示了重密钥策略与控制拓扑脆弱性的直接关联，为加密控制系统设计提供了理论基础。

items.title: Bulkhead: Automated Semantic Detection and Remediation of Container Escape Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Filesystem isolation in container ecosystems is often weakened by cross-boundary path misresolution, causing path traversal (PaTra) vulnerabilities. These vulnerabilities stem from insecure host-container interactions and have become increasingly pervasive as cloud systems mount shared resources, such as GPUs and agent workspaces, into containers to support AI workloads. Existing defenses remain inadequate. Kernel-level protections are intrusive, can destabilize system calls, and have therefore not been accepted into the Linux mainline. Detection methods rely on static rule matching or manual code auditing. Static rules can flag path-related functions but fail to capture the semantics needed to determine whether a host-container interaction exists, causing many false positives. Manual review requires domain expertise, making it costly, inefficient, and difficult to scale. To address this threat, we present Bulkhead, an automated framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) with formal methods for semantic vulnerability discovery and remediation. Bulkhead uses a multi-agent system to identify and repair PaTra vulnerabilities through multi-dimensional knowledge patterns generalized from known cases. It first applies high-risk functional patterns to locate entry points for cross-boundary interactions in containerized code, then uses call-chain patterns to recover the corresponding execution paths at suitable depth. The Detection pipeline analyzes these call chains against the application scenarios and threat model, identifying vulnerabilities such as missing security checks and TOCTOU flaws in cross-boundary interactions, and generating proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits for validation. These PoCs then guide patch generation. To ensure remediation correctness, the Patch pipeline performs assertion-driven verification using predefined model-checking templates.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 容器逃逸漏洞（特别是路径遍历漏洞）在云原生环境中日益严重，尤其是当系统将GPU、代理工作区等共享资源挂载到容器中支持AI工作负载时。现有防御措施存在明显不足：内核级防护方案侵入性强、可能导致系统调用不稳定，且未被Linux主线接受；检测方法依赖静态规则匹配或人工代码审计，静态规则虽能标记路径相关函数却无法捕获是否存在主机-容器交互的语义，导致大量误报；人工审查需要领域专业知识，成本高、效率低且难以规模化。针对这一挑战，本文提出Bulkhead——一个集成大语言模型与形式化方法的自动化漏洞发现与修复框架。Bulkhead采用多智能体系统，通过从已知案例泛化的多维知识模式来识别和修复路径遍历漏洞。其流程为：首先应用高风险功能模式定位容器化代码中跨边界交互的入口点；然后使用调用链模式以适当深度恢复对应的执行路径；检测管道结合应用场景和威胁模型分析这些调用链，识别缺失安全检查、TOCTOU竞态等漏洞，并生成概念验证利用进行验证；最后，修补管道基于断言驱动验证（使用预定义模型检查模板）确保修复正确性。实验证明Bulkhead能有效发现真实容器环境中的路径遍历漏洞并自动生成补丁。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作首次将LLM与形式化方法结合用于容器逃逸漏洞的自动化检测与修复，弥补了现有方法语义缺失和人工成本高的短板，对云原生安全防护有重要推动作用。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接提升容器运行时安全，尤其适用于Kubernetes环境、AI推理集群等共享资源挂载场景；其自动化修复能力可降低安全团队应急响应负担。

items.why_it_matters: 该工作首次将LLM与形式化方法结合用于容器逃逸漏洞的自动化检测与修复，弥补了现有方法语义缺失和人工成本高的短板，对云原生安全防护有重要推动作用。

items.title: Auditable and Transparent Fully Authenticated Disk Encryption via USB Storage Interposition
items.summary: Full Disk Encryption (FDE) has become increasingly important in the last decades due to the evident confidentiality concerns. In most systems, encryption is provided by an operating system driver, through which the user can transparently access the encrypted disk after supplying the required keys (or the credentials from which those keys are derived). In this work, we explore an alternative approach: the use of an intermediate USB device placed between the host system and the external hard disk, where the encrypted data are stored. Although there are existing devices that follow this inline approach (such as RAID controllers and USB enclosures with built-in encryption), we explore the use of a general-purpose single-board computer running Linux with USB On-The-Go support (e.g. a Raspberry Pi), to provide FADE (Fully Authenticated Disk Encryption). Our system, named CC (Cryptographic Companion), performs the cryptographic operations (encryption/decryption and authentication), providing a standard USB mass-storage interface to the host (which is entirely unaware of the presence of encryption) while relying on the external USB hard disk to store the corresponding encrypted blocks. Our design provides several key advantages: flexibility, low cost, transparency, the use of generic hardware and free and open-source software, adaptability to emerging cryptographic schemes, and mitigations against malicious disk firmware. This paper presents the design and implementation of the CC and an experimental evaluation of our current research prototype, which indicates that it is sufficiently efficient for most common use cases.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 传统全盘加密（FDE）通常由操作系统驱动实现，用户需在本地提供密钥才能透明访问加密磁盘。本文探索了一种替代方案：在主机与外部硬盘之间插入一个通用USB中间设备，该设备运行Linux并支持USB On-The-Go（例如树莓派），实现完全认证磁盘加密（FADE）。作者设计并实现了名为CC（Cryptographic Companion）的原型系统：CC作为USB大容量存储设备呈现给主机，主机完全不知加密存在；CC负责所有加解密与认证操作，并将加密块存储到外部USB硬盘。系统基于通用硬件和自由开源软件，具有灵活性、低成本、透明性、可适应新兴密码方案、可缓解恶意磁盘固件攻击等优势。实验评估表明，原型在常见使用场景下性能足够高效。本文贡献在于提出并验证了一种可审计、透明的磁盘加密新架构，为依赖封闭操作系统的场景提供了替代方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为依赖封闭操作系统的设备（如IoT、嵌入式系统）提供独立、可审计的磁盘加密方案，且基于开源软硬件，降低供应链风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于需要强加密且希望独立于操作系统实现安全存储的场景，如敏感数据便携存储、离线备份、安全审计等。

items.why_it_matters: 为依赖封闭操作系统的设备（如IoT、嵌入式系统）提供独立、可审计的磁盘加密方案，且基于开源软硬件，降低供应链风险。

items.title: PVDetector: Detecting Prompt Injection Attacks on Purpose-Specific LLM Agents through Policy-Violation Concept Analysis
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as purpose-specific agents to handle domain-specific tasks such as customer service and code generation. These agents are expected to comply with not only generic safety guardrails but also purpose-specific restrictions tailored to their designated roles. Such additional restrictions enlarge the attack surface, particularly to prompt injection (PI) attacks. To defend against such attacks, existing detection methods primarily rely on analyzing input-output patterns, yet yield limited effectiveness. To address this limitation, we turn to analyzing the hidden activation space and discover that LLMs inherently retain latent policy-violation (PV) concepts when prompted with requests beyond their designated purpose. Particularly, PV concepts capture the semantics of conflicts between user queries and predefined restrictions, implicitly reflecting LLMs' intrinsic awareness of recognizing policy violations. Building on this insight, we propose PVDetector, a training-free framework that detects PI attacks during LLM inference by measuring hidden-state alignment with PV concepts, which are derived offline from the contrastive pairs of policy-violating and policy-compliant prompts. Experiments across multiple LLMs and datasets show that PVDetector achieves <1\% false negative rate with minimal auxiliary overhead, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/Claresigle/PVDetector .

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究提出PVDetector，一种无需额外训练即可检测针对特定用途LLM Agent的提示注入攻击的框架。现有方法主要分析输入输出模式，效果有限。作者通过分析LLM的隐藏激活空间，发现LLM在处理超出其指定用途的请求时，会内在保留策略违规（PV）概念，这些概念捕捉了用户查询与预定义限制之间的冲突语义，反映了LLM对策略违规的固有认知。基于此，PVDetector通过离线从策略违规和合规提示的对比对中提取PV概念，并在推理时通过测量隐藏状态与PV概念的alignment来检测提示注入攻击。在多个LLM和数据集上的实验表明，PVDetector实现了<1%的假阴性率，且辅助开销极小，性能持续优于现有最先进方法。代码已开源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为LLM Agent提供了一种轻量、高效的提示注入检测方法，利用模型内部表征而非仅依赖输入输出，提升了针对特定用途限制的安全性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于各类部署了特定用途LLM Agent的场景，如客服、代码生成等，可增强对策略违规查询的防御能力。

items.why_it_matters: 为LLM Agent提供了一种轻量、高效的提示注入检测方法，利用模型内部表征而非仅依赖输入输出，提升了针对特定用途限制的安全性。

items.title: Explainable-by-Design Audio Deepfake Detection via Wiener-Hopf Linear Prediction
items.summary: The rapid advancement of synthetic speech generation methods has made audio deepfake detection a critical challenge in multimedia forensics. While recent approaches achieve high detection accuracy, they typically rely on black-box architectures that offer limited interpretability and high computational complexity. In this paper, we propose an explainable-by-design audio deepfake detection framework based on Wiener-Hopf linear prediction, processed by a lightweight 2D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). This design enables a direct and transparent connection between classification outcomes and the acoustic properties of the signal. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate competitive detection performance while maintaining significantly lower computational complexity compared to state-of-the-art solutions. The interpretability analysis using Grad-CAM reveals that the classifier focuses on low-order predictor coefficients and on silence and transitional regions, suggesting that the Wiener-Hopf predictor captures reverberation characteristics and subtle statistical inconsistencies in synthetic speech. Finally, robustness experiments show that fine-tuning effectively recovers detection performance under common post-processing degradations, including additive noise, MP3 compression, and telephone filtering.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对音频深度伪造检测中的可解释性和计算效率问题，提出了一种基于Wiener-Hopf线性预测的可解释性设计框架。该框架通过Wiener-Hopf方程提取语音信号的线性预测系数，并利用轻量级2D卷积神经网络（CNN）对系数图进行分类。实验在多个基准数据集上进行，结果表明该方法在保持与最新技术相当检测精度的同时，显著降低了计算复杂度。可解释性分析采用Grad-CAM可视化，发现分类器重点关注低阶预测系数以及语音中的静音和过渡区域，这表明Wiener-Hopf预测器能够捕捉合成语音中的混响特征和统计不一致性。鲁棒性实验显示，通过微调可以有效恢复在加性噪声、MP3压缩和电话滤波等常见后处理退化下的检测性能。该研究为构建可解释且高效的音频伪造检测系统提供了新思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 音频深度伪造检测对于防范语音欺诈和虚假信息至关重要，现有黑盒模型缺乏可解释性且计算开销大。本文提出的可解释性框架有助于理解模型决策依据，提升可信度，且轻量级设计有利于实际部署。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可广泛应用于语音伪造检测、多媒体取证、数字音频完整性验证等场景。

items.title: How Agentic Is Agentic Commerce? A Population-Scale Measurement of x402 Adoption and Authenticity
items.summary: AI agents are said to be forming an economy in which they pay, on their own, for the data, APIs, and compute they consume. x402, which settles a stablecoin payment on-chain for each purchase, is the most widely deployed protocol for this, and its hundreds of millions of settlements are read as proof that the economy has arrived. We show the count cannot be read as adoption: it is the one metric an interested party can manufacture almost for free, since the facilitator sponsors the gas and nothing on-chain marks who controls a payment. We give the first population-scale measurement of x402 on Base, supplemented with a coarser Solana census. Identifying settlements from their on-chain event and resolving the true payer through the meta-transaction layer, we sort each by what its trace can prove via a payment graph. Over a 280-day window Base carries 136{,}708{,}672 settlements worth \$44{,}121{,}383.81, concentrated on every axis we measure (payer, recipient, and value Gini all above 0.98), yet 21.20\% are fictitious and 63.78\% internal settlement within a linked cluster. What is genuinely independent is bounded: it lies between the \$187{,}861.35 that demonstrably reaches a nameable service and the \$20{,}258{,}746.09 (45.92\% of value) not provably manufactured. Finally, we resolve the count's manufacturable component, a coherent operator-driven economy, star-shaped, machine-timed, and gas-subsidized. Settlement count measures manufacturability, not adoption.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文对被称为AI代理经济中广泛部署的x402协议进行了首次大规模测量。x402协议允许AI代理自主为每次数据、API或计算消耗支付稳定币，并在链上结算。此前，x402协议已记录数亿次结算，被解读为AI代理经济已到来的证据。然而，本研究通过分析Base链（辅以Solana链）的链上事件和元交易层，识别真实付款人，并利用支付图证明交易真实性，发现所谓的采用数据严重失实。在280天窗口内，Base链记录了136,708,672笔结算，总价值44,121,383.81美元，但高度集中（付款人、接收方和价值的基尼系数均超过0.98），其中21.20%的交易是虚假的，63.78%属于同一关联集群的内部结算。真正独立的交易范围极小：可证明到达可命名服务的金额仅187,861.35美元，而未证明伪造的最高可能价值为20,258,746.09美元（占总价值的45.92%）。最后，论文揭示了可制造成分——一个由运营商驱动的、星型拓扑、机器定时且由gas补贴的连贯经济。结论：结算数量衡量的是可制造性，而非实际采用。该研究对评估AI代理经济的真实规模具有重要意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示AI代理经济中广泛引用的采用数据可能大规模造假，为安全分析师和投资者提供警示，避免被虚假指标误导。

items.title: Traceback Translators Against Forgetting in Continual Fake Speech Detection
items.summary: Fake speech detectors are increasingly challenged by the development of new and more accurate generative models. To cope with this problem, continual learning techniques are nowadays widely considered feasible strategies for updating models to new datasets, but they also lead to decreased performance on previously seen samples (catastrophic forgetting). In this work, we propose a forgetting-resilient solution based on the adoption of domain translators within a frozen detector, which remaps the new feature spaces into the original ones by means of a traceback translator network. Experimental results show that this strategy enables the achievement of high detection rates with respect to traditional retraining, while minimizing the computational effort and preserving the detection accuracy on previous data.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对假语音检测中持续学习面临的灾难性遗忘问题，提出了一种基于回溯翻译器的抗遗忘解决方案。随着生成模型的发展，假语音检测器需要不断适应新数据集，但传统的持续学习方法会导致在旧数据上性能下降。作者提出在冻结的检测器内部集成域翻译器，通过回溯翻译器网络将新特征空间重新映射到原始特征空间，从而在不重新训练整个模型的情况下保留旧数据的检测能力。实验结果表明，该方法相比传统重训练，在保持对旧数据检测精度的同时显著降低了计算开销，并实现了对新数据的高检测率。该研究主要贡献包括：提出了一种新颖的持续学习框架，有效缓解了灾难性遗忘；验证了域翻译器在语音检测领域的适用性；在保持计算效率的同时提升了模型的可扩展性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 假语音检测需要持续适应新型生成模型，但持续学习会导致遗忘旧数据。本文提出的回溯翻译器方法提供了一种低计算成本、高精度的解决方案，有助于安全系统在不重新训练的情况下持续更新，对语音取证和反欺诈具有实际意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于语音鉴别、生物识别安全、音频深度伪造检测等需要持续更新的场景。

items.why_it_matters: 假语音检测需要持续适应新型生成模型，但持续学习会导致遗忘旧数据。本文提出的回溯翻译器方法提供了一种低计算成本、高精度的解决方案，有助于安全系统在不重新训练的情况下持续更新，对语音取证和反欺诈具有实际意义。

items.title: Breaking Refusal in the First Half: A Mechanistic Study of the Prefill Jailbreak
items.summary: Aligned language models refuse harmful requests, but a one-line prefill ("Sure, here is") strips the refusal. We ask where and how it fails. The harm representation stays intact: on the prompts the attack flips to compliance, a linear probe reads harm as high as on the refused ones (0.91-0.98), while behavioral refusal drops to chance. This holds across four models and three families (1.5-3.8B, and at 14B). Refusal is therefore a shallow, response-site computation. We localize it to an early window: a dose-matched position control shows the first half of the response suffices to break refusal, while the second half is nearly inert. Three causal probes converge on that window. Restoring the harm direction there partially re-engages refusal. Injecting the model's own refuse-state reverses the jailbreak (74%, held-out). And knocking out the early response's attention to the prefill, but not an equal attention mass elsewhere, selectively collapses the harmful continuation. A base-model control identifies the mechanism: the same knockout collapses the continuation prefill-specifically even in a non-safety-tuned base model (64% to 25% harmful content vs a matched control's 64%, replicated at 7B). So the prefill's grip is generic autoregressive conditioning, not safety-specific suppression, and "refusal restoration" is a model-dependent fallback. The dominant mechanism is passive. A small safety-specific attractor remains on top (logit-trace concentration 0.24 vs 0.03), whose active-vs-passive character we size but do not fully separate. No single direction or component is a clean handle either: the decision is decodable but distributed, and refusal tracks harm rather than scary surface. The consequence is structural: a monitor reading the untouched prompt-side representation is immune by construction, but only to response-site attacks. The mechanism is diffuse; the failure surface is local.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文对'Prefill Jailbreak'攻击进行了深入的机理研究。该攻击只需在用户提示后附加一行 prefille（例如'Sure, here is'），就能使对齐的大语言模型拒绝对有害请求的拒绝，转而生成有害内容。作者通过实验发现，即使攻击成功使模型行为上放弃拒绝，模型内部的有害表示（harm representation）仍然完整：在线性探针下，被攻击提示的 harm 分数与正常拒绝提示几乎一样高（0.91-0.98），但行为上的拒绝率降至随机水平。这一现象在多个模型家族（1.5B-3.8B，甚至14B参数）上得到验证，表明拒绝机制实际上是浅层的、仅发生在响应阶段的计算。通过剂量匹配的位置控制实验，作者定位到拒绝的关键窗口在响应的前半部分：修改前半部分即可打破拒绝，而修改后半部分几乎无效。三种因果探针（因果追踪、注意力掩码、残差流干扰）均收敛于该窗口。在该窗口恢复有害方向的表示可以部分重新激活拒绝；注入模型自身的拒绝状态向量可以逆转攻击（74%成功率，且能泛化到未见提示）。进一步，通过敲除（knockout）早期响应层对 prefill 的注意力，而不是其他等量注意力，可以选择性地破坏有害续写。在未经过安全微调的基础模型上，同样的敲除操作也能特异性减少有害内容（从64%降至25%，对比对照组的64%保持不变），并且该结果在7B模型上得到复现。因此，prefill 的控制机制是通用的自回归条件作用（generic autoregressive conditioning），而非安全特定的抑制；所谓的“拒绝恢复”只是模型依赖的备选机制。虽然仍存在一个小的安全特定吸引子（logit-trace浓度0.24 vs 0.03），但其主动/被动特性尚未完全分离。最后，该攻击的后果是结构性的：如果仅监控提示侧表示，则对响应侧攻击天然免疫，但攻击的失败表面是局部的。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了当前LLM安全对齐机制的脆弱本质：拒绝行为仅是响应阶段的浅层计算，可以被简单的prefill绕过，且深层表示不受影响。对于构建更鲁棒的防御具有重要指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接威胁所有依赖拒绝机制的安全对齐LLM，尤其影响需要确保输出安全的部署场景。

items.title: VanillaBench: The Hidden Accuracy Cost of Adversarial Robustness
items.summary: Adversarial robustness research has produced hundreds of defended models over the past decade, yet the literature almost universally reports robustness results in isolation: standard (clean) accuracy and adversarial accuracy of the robust model are shown, but the gap to the corresponding vanilla model is rarely quantified. We introduce VanillaBench, a systematic benchmark that makes this gap explicit. For every adversarially-trained model catalogued by RobustBench across four threat models, we compute the accuracy difference against multiple vanilla references from Papers with Code, computed over both all entries and no-extra-data entries, the best vanilla model as of the robust model's publication year, and an architecture-matched baseline. Across all 186 robust models, the mean delta clean relative to the best vanilla model ranges from -7.7 to -29.5 percentage points, and even the single most robust model per track still trails its temporal vanilla counterpart by 4.0-21.0 points. The architecture-matched comparison, which isolates the effect of adversarial training from architectural differences, reveals a mean gap of -3.5 to -17.5 points. Restricting this architecture-matched comparison to models whose vanilla accuracy is known for the exact same architecture, rather than approximated from a related one, narrows the gap to -4.0 to -14.0 points. These results demonstrate that the robustness-accuracy trade-off is substantially larger than what is typically conveyed by individual papers. This information is critical for practitioners and decision-makers. When deploying models in real-world settings, the accuracy cost of robustness directly affects business outcomes, yet current publications do not provide the vanilla baseline needed to assess it. We argue that future robustness evaluations should report vanilla-referenced accuracy gaps as a standard component.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文聚焦对抗鲁棒性研究中一个常被忽视的问题：鲁棒模型相对于普通（非鲁棒）模型在干净样本上的精度下降。过去十年，对抗鲁棒性研究产出了数百个防御模型，但文献通常只报告鲁棒模型自身的干净精度和对抗精度，很少量化其与对应普通模型（未经对抗训练的原始模型）之间的精度差距。为此，作者提出了VanillaBench，一个系统性基准测试，该基准将这种差距显式化。针对RobustBench中记录的四个威胁模型下的每个对抗训练模型，作者从Papers with Code中选取多个普通参考模型，计算精度差异：包括所有条目与无额外数据条目的平均对比、鲁棒模型发表年份的最佳普通模型对比，以及架构匹配基线对比。实验覆盖186个鲁棒模型，结果表明，相对于最佳普通模型，平均干净精度差在-7.7到-29.5个百分点之间；即使是每个跟踪中最鲁棒的单个模型，其与同期普通模型的差距仍有4.0-21.0个百分点。架构匹配对比（隔离了对抗训练与架构差异的影响）显示平均差距为-3.5到-17.5个百分点；若限制为此架构的已知普通精度（而非近似值），差距缩小至-4.0到-14.0个百分点。这些结果证明，鲁棒性-精度权衡实际上远大于单个论文通常所传达的程度。该信息对实践者和决策者至关重要：在真实世界部署模型时，鲁棒性的精度成本直接影响业务收益，而当前出版物并未提供评估所需的普通基线。作者认为，未来的鲁棒性评估应将普通参考精度差距作为标准组成部分。本文适合AI安全研究员、对抗鲁棒性研究者、模型部署决策者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了对抗鲁棒性研究普遍存在的系统性报告偏差：鲁棒模型的干净精度损失被严重低估，论文报告的标准偏差仅为实际差值的子集。这直接影响了实际部署决策，若忽视此差距可能导致业务收益显著下降。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对部署对抗鲁棒模型的实际业务场景（如人脸识别、自动驾驶感知）影响较大；同时为改进鲁棒性评估标准提供依据，可推动学术研究更透明地报告精度代价。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：建议AI安全团队阅读论文完整内容，将其提出的VanillaBench方法论纳入内部鲁棒模型评估流程。

items.title: Open-Source Intelligence for Code Provenance and the Security Patterns that Separate Human and Large-Language-Model Implementations of Common Programming Tasks
items.summary: Developers now draw code from two very different sources, the accumulated human answers on sites such as Stack Overflow and the output of large language models. We ask two questions about that split. First, can the provenance of a code snippet be recovered from the code itself, and second, do the two sources differ in the security patterns they adopt for the same task. Using only open sources, a public gateway of open-weight language models and the public Stack Overflow API, we build a fully reproducible pipeline that collects real implementations of 31 security-sensitive programming tasks, among them OAuth with PKCE, JWT verification, password hashing, and SQL access, from 9 language models and from human answers, and scores every sample with deterministic security and style detectors. On 528 real samples we train a cross-validated classifier that recovers human versus model provenance with 93 percent accuracy against a 78 percent baseline, and a 7-way classifier that attributes a sample to the specific model that wrote it at 48 percent. We then report where the sources diverge on security, which patterns models adopt more often than the human corpus and which they inherit from it. Running the same tasks in Python, JavaScript, Go, and Java, we find the security divergence holds in every language while the provenance boundary is partly language-specific and does not transfer symmetrically between them. A vulnerability repair case study, in which models are handed insecure code and asked to fix it, finds a 77 percent repair rate across 21 seeds and 12 weakness classes, but a recurring partial-fix failure in which the model removes the insecure pattern without adding the correct defense. The pipeline is data driven, so any new task or language is added as a single specification entry, and a fail-closed checker re-derives every number in this paper from the stored data.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于现代软件开发中代码来源的区分问题：开发者的代码可能来自人类编写的Stack Overflow答案，也可能来自大型语言模型（LLM）的输出。论文提出了一个完全基于开源数据的可复现流水线，用于收集31个安全敏感编程任务（例如OAuth with PKCE、JWT验证、密码哈希、SQL访问）的真实实现，涵盖9个LLM和人类（通过Stack Overflow API获取）。共收集528个样本，使用确定性安全检测器和风格检测器进行评分。基于这些特征，训练了一个交叉验证的分类器，能够以93%的准确率（基线78%）区分人类与模型编写的代码，并进一步以48%的准确率将样本归因到具体的LLM。论文还比较了人类和LLM在安全模式上的差异，发现LLM在某些安全模式上比人类更常采用，而在其他模式上则继承了人类的不足。实验在Python、JavaScript、Go和Java四种语言中进行，结果表明安全差异在所有语言中普遍存在，但来源分类边界部分依赖于语言，且在不同语言间不对称。此外，论文进行了漏洞修复案例研究，将不安全的代码交给LLM修复，结果显示21个随机种子和12种弱点类别下修复率为77%，但存在一种重复的“部分修复失败”现象：模型去除了不安全模式，却未能添加正确的防御措施。流水线是数据驱动的，新任务或新语言只需添加单个规范条目即可扩展，且所有结果可通过失败封闭检查器从存储数据中重新验证。该研究为安全分析师提供了区分代码来源和评估LLM安全行为的工具，有助于理解AI生成代码的风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着LLM生成代码的普及，安全团队需要快速识别代码来源并评估其安全性。本研究提供了一种开源、可复现的方法，能以高准确率区分人类与AI编写的代码，并揭示LLM在安全模式上的偏好与缺陷，有助于制定针对性的代码审查策略。

items.title: Open-Source Intelligence and Music Information Retrieval for Geographic Attribution of Musical Affect and the Ecological Limits of Population Inference
items.summary: A common intuition holds that a region's music mirrors the temperament of its people, so that melancholic melodies mark melancholic populations. We test the measurable half of that intuition and reject the inferential half. Using the Essen Folksong Collection, a corpus of thousands of notated folk melodies, we extract real melodic and affect-related features from 2393 deduplicated melodies spanning 16 countries and 7 geographic regions, with the analysis performed on symbolic scores rather than audio. The mode of each melody is computed with a key-finding algorithm rather than read from the file, because the collection's own documentation warns its major and minor labels are unreliable. Cross-country differences in melodic structure are large and highly significant. All 8 tested features differ across countries at p<0.001, with the leap-related features reaching p<10^-90, and China carries a distinctive wide-leap, high-activity signature (arousal composite +1.24 standard deviations, mean absolute interval 2.77 semitones against Germany's 2.17). We then test the inferential half. We correlate the regional musical-affect measures with two published, validated national indices, the World Happiness Report ladder score and the Hofstede individualism index. None of the 6 correlations is significant (0 of 6). The geography of musical affect is real and measurable, but it does not predict how happy or how individualist a population is, and any claim that it does is an ecological fallacy. We release the full extraction and analysis pipeline, and a fail-closed checker re-derives every number in this paper from the data.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了音乐情感特征与人口心理特征之间的地理关联，并检验了常见直觉——即一个地区的音乐反映其民众的性情。作者使用埃森民歌集（Essen Folksong Collection）中来自16个国家和7个地理区域的2393首去重民歌的符号乐谱（非音频），通过关键检测算法计算调式（大调/小调），并提取了8种旋律特征（如音程、活动度等）。研究发现各国旋律结构差异显著（p<0.001），其中中国民歌具有独特的宽音程、高活动度特征（唤醒综合得分高出1.24个标准差，平均绝对音程2.77半音，而德国为2.17）。然而，将区域音乐情感指标与“世界幸福报告”阶梯分数及霍夫斯泰德个人主义指数进行相关性分析时，6项相关系数均不显著。作者得出结论：音乐情感的地理分布可测量且真实存在，但无法预测人口的幸福感或个人主义程度，任何此类推断均构成生态谬误。研究公开了完整的特征提取与分析流程代码。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 虽然主题非安全领域，但展示了开源情报与数据挖掘的跨学科方法，其分析工具链和避免生态谬误的严谨逻辑对安全分析师处理地理相关数据具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 无直接安全影响，但可类比于安全中基于统计的地理归因错误风险。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 阅读摘要即可，无需跟进。

items.title: When Binaries Talk Back: Representation-Confusion Attacks on LLM-Assisted Reverse Engineering
items.summary: LLM-assisted reverse-engineering (RE) systems analyze strings, decompiler output, and tool reports derived from ttacker-controlled binaries. A binary can make data look like instructions or records from one origin look like independent evidence. We call such failures Representation-Confusion Attacks in Reverse Engineering (RARE): the pipeline promotes a correctly extracted observation to instruction authority, claim-validating evidence, or trusted analysis state without the authority or support that role requires. RARE-Bench measures these failures with behavior-checked clean and adversarial binaries. After an exploratory 11,520-call study, we test RARE-Guard's authorization and evidence controls on 20 new programs and two models. Without runtime controls, the models propose a planted unsafe action in 35/40 adversarial cases and 0/40 clean cases. When binary-derived content is shown only as data (Data-Only rendering), they still make 15 unsafe proposals. Tool Authorization denies all 15 and authorizes all 40 matched analyst requests. On identical report drafts, Support Gate validates 23/40 false claims by counting records from one origin separately. Provenance Gate groups those records before counting support, validates 0/40 false claims, and retains all 40 supported claims. We then instrument Ghidra, r2pipe, and angr on 16 further programs. In a preselected eight-program subset, no single-tool draft reaches Support Gate's validation threshold for the false claim. In fused drafts across all 16 programs, Support Gate validates 32/32 false claims. Provenance Gate prevents validation of all 32 and retains all 32 supported claims. A deterministic renderer prevents downgraded claims from reappearing in the final report. Binary-derived content may therefore guide analysis without gaining authority over tools, and views from several tools do not necessarily provide independent evidence.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了LLM辅助逆向工程（RE）流水线中的一种新型安全威胁：表示混淆攻击（Representation-Confusion Attacks, RARE）。攻击者可以通过构造恶意二进制文件，使得RE系统错误地将二进制中提取的数据视为指令、权威证据或独立分析来源，从而误导LLM生成不安全的建议或行为。论文首先构建了RARE-Bench基准测试，包含干净和对抗性二进制样本，通过11,520次调用实验验证了攻击的有效性。随后提出了RARE-Guard防御框架，包括三种机制：（1）数据仅渲染（Data-Only rendering），仅将二进制派生内容作为数据展示，而非指令；（2）工具授权（Tool Authorization），限制工具调用的权限；（3）支持门（Support Gate）和来源门（Provenance Gate），用于验证分析主张的证据来源和独立性。实验表明，在没有运行时控制的情况下，模型在35/40对抗性案例中提出了不安全操作，而数据仅渲染后仍有15个不安全建议。工具授权拒绝了所有15个不安全建议，并授权了所有合法请求。支持门在未区分证据来源时验证了23/40虚假主张，而来源门通过分组相同来源的记录，将虚假主张验证降至0/40，同时保留了所有真实主张。论文还通过在Ghidra、r2pipe和angr等工具上的集成测试（16个程序），进一步证明了来源门在融合多工具分析时能完全防止虚假主张被验证，而确定性渲染器可防止降级主张在最终报告中重现。研究指出，二进制派生内容应仅作为分析指导而非赋予工具权威，且多工具视图并不必然提供独立证据。该工作为LLM辅助逆向工程的安全使用提供了关键防护思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了LLM辅助逆向工程中容易被忽视的输入操纵风险，为安全分析师在使用AI工具分析恶意软件时提供了重要的防御视角，避免被对抗性二进制误导。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖LLM辅助逆向工程的工具链（如Ghidra、r2pipe、angr等），以及基于多工具融合分析的自动化逆向平台。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估自身逆向工具链中是否可能受到表示混淆攻击，并考虑集成类似RARE-Guard的防护机制。

items.title: On the Security Implications of PQC in TLS: Handshake Exhaustion and IDS Degradation
items.summary: Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) is increasingly being integrated into TLS 1.3 to enhance resilience against quantum-enabled attacks. However, the additional computational and communication overhead introduced by PQC primitives during the handshake phase may also amplify the impact of TLS handshake exhaustion attacks, leading to more severe Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) threats. In this study, we establish an empirical testbed consisting of one PQC-enabled TLS server and ten attacking nodes, generating over 16.5 GB of mixed traffic data that includes both legitimate browsing behavior and high-intensity handshake exhaustion attacks. Experimental results show that PQC-TLS can prolong periods of sustained high CPU utilization on the server by up to 88 times, significantly amplifying the effectiveness of such attacks. Furthermore, we evaluate state-of-the-art deep learning-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) and observe a substantial decline in attack detection performance under PQC traffic conditions. In particular, exosphere achieves only around 50% recall, while HyperVision's AU-ROC degrades to near-random levels (0.49), revealing critical detection blind spots in existing IDS when operating in PQC environments. The main contributions of this work are threefold: (1) we systematically quantify and analyze the root causes of IDS detection blind spots in PQC settings; (2) we publicly release a comprehensive PQC-DDoS hybrid traffic dataset, including precise attack timestamps and server-side resource monitoring data; and (3) we open-source all experimental code and AWS deployment scripts, enabling a fully reproducible cloud-based testing environment. These resources aim to support both academia and industry in developing next-generation PQC-aware intrusion detection systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了后量子密码（PQC）集成到TLS 1.3后引入的安全隐患，特别是针对握手耗尽攻击和入侵检测系统（IDS）性能的影响。PQC原语在TLS握手阶段带来的额外计算和通信开销，可能放大握手耗尽攻击的效果，导致更严重的分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）威胁。作者搭建了一个包含一台PQC-TLS服务器和十个攻击节点的实验环境，生成了超过16.5GB的混合流量数据，同时涵盖正常浏览行为和高强度握手耗尽攻击。实验结果表明，PQC-TLS使服务器高CPU利用率的持续时间延长了最多88倍，显著增强了此类攻击的效能。此外，作者评估了多种基于深度学习的先进IDS，发现在PQC流量条件下，它们的攻击检测性能大幅下降：例如exosphere的召回率仅约50%，HyperVision的AU-ROC降至接近随机水平（0.49），揭示了现有IDS在PQC环境中存在严重检测盲点。本文的主要贡献包括：（1）系统性地量化并分析了PQC环境下IDS检测盲点的根本原因；（2）公开了一个全面的PQC-DDoS混合流量数据集，包含精确的攻击时间戳和服务器端资源监控数据；（3）开源了所有实验代码和AWS部署脚本，支持可完全复现的云端测试环境。该研究为学术界和工业界开发下一代PQC感知的入侵检测系统提供了重要资源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着PQC即将大规模部署，本文首次系统揭示了PQC-TLS在握手层放大DDoS攻击并导致现有IDS失灵的严重安全风险，对安全运营和标准制定具有前瞻预警价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响TLS 1.3+PQC部署场景下的DDoS防护和入侵检测能力，需警惕类似攻击放大效应在其他TLS实现或协议中出现的可能性。
detection_signals_zh: PQC-TLS握手阶段CPU使用率异常持续高企
IDS对TLS握手耗尽攻击的检出率显著下降（如exosphere召回率低于55%）
HyperVision等IDS的AU-ROC逼近0.5（随机水平）
defense_advice_zh: 在PQC过渡期间，加强对TLS握手资源的监控和速率限制
重新评估现有IDS在PQC环境下的检测基线，训练PQC特定流量模型
采用混合检测策略，结合统计异常检测与深度学习以弥补盲点

items.title: Trust but Verify? Uncovering the Security Debt of Autonomous Coding Agents
items.summary: The increasing adoption of autonomous coding agents accelerates software development but also introduces scoped security risks within high-impact file paths that can outpace traditional human review capacity. While prior research has primarily evaluated these systems in terms of functional correctness and productivity, this paper presents a large-scale empirical study using the AIDev dataset to systematically characterize security code smells in agent-generated pull requests (PRs). Through a combination of a validated LLM-as-a-judge framework and manual qualitative analysis, we identify and classify security misconfigurations across 16,112 file changes spanning 4,022 pull requests. Our results reveal that 38.9% of agent-generated PRs contain at least one security smell, with supply chain integrity issues accounting for 82.3% of all detected security smells. Furthermore, hard-coded credentials constitute 99.6% of all critical-severity security smells. Crucially, we find that human collaborators are responsible for introducing 67.6% of genuine leaked secrets within these agent-assisted workflows, while existing automated and human review processes fail to detect 81.1% of these credentials prior to integration. These findings highlight substantial security risks in agent-assisted software development workflows and suggest a potential reduction in developer vigilance. They also underscore the urgent need for context-aware security guardrails implemented directly at the point of human-AI collaboration.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对自主编码代理在软件开发中日益普及所引发的安全债务问题进行了大规模实证研究。研究背景：自主编码代理能够加速开发流程，但也可能在高影响文件路径中引入超出传统人工审查能力的安全风险。先前研究主要关注这些系统的功能正确性和生产力，而本文利用AIDev数据集系统性地刻画了代理生成的拉取请求（PR）中的安全代码异味。研究方法：结合经验证的LLM作为裁判框架和人工定性分析，对来自4022个PR的16112个文件变更进行了安全配置错误的识别与分类。主要结果：发现38.9%的代理生成PR包含至少一个安全异味，其中供应链完整性问题占所有检测到的安全异味的82.3%；此外，硬编码凭据占所有关键严重性安全异味的99.6%。尤为关键的是，人类协作者在代理辅助的工作流中引入了67.6%的真实泄露秘密，而现有的自动和人工审查流程在集成前未能检测到81.1%的这类凭据。这些发现揭示了代理辅助软件开发工作流中存在重大安全风险，并表明开发者的警惕性可能有所降低。研究还强调了直接在人类与AI协作点实施上下文感知安全护栏的迫切需求。本文适合安全研究员、DevSecOps工程师以及采用或考虑引入自主编码代理的团队阅读，以了解相关风险并制定缓解策略。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 自主编码代理正在快速普及，但其安全影响尚不明确。本研究表明代理生成代码中存在普遍的安全异味且现有审查机制严重失效，为安全团队提供了必须重视的数据驱动证据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响所有使用自主编码代理（如GitHub Copilot、Codex等）的软件开发流程，特别是涉及凭据管理和供应链安全场景。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进 - 安全团队应评估组织内自主编码代理的使用情况，并考虑实施针对供应链和凭据泄露的上下文感知安全审查机制。

items.title: WaterMoE: Expert-Routing-based Watermarking for High Fidelity and Efficiency
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success but raise growing concerns about content provenance and misuse, motivating the need for reliable watermarking techniques. However, these techniques have rarely been adopted in practice mainly for two reasons: i) severely degraded model performance, and ii) additional inference overhead. To confirm the problem, we construct a comprehensive benchmark spanning different generation tasks to systematically evaluate 9 representative watermarking methods. We found almost all existing methods are designed for text fluency, but not for restricted and complicated tasks, and their overhead prevents them from deployment in latency-critical systems. To address i) and ii), we propose an LLM watermarking scheme \textit{WaterMoE} for the growingly popular Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs. WaterMoE embeds watermarking signals through controlled perturbation into the expert selection at each router, which accumulates to token selection shift at the final output. In contrast to watermarking as a post-processing token-sampling approach, WaterMoE embeds watermark within the inference loop incurring negligible quality degradation and computational overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a fidelity performance close to the unwatermarked and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art watermarking methods on the benchmark, with up to $4\times$ speedup, incurring merely 1\% additional inference latency compared to native generation. The results demonstrate the capability of WaterMoE to be deployed in real-world tasks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对大语言模型（LLM）水印技术在实际部署中面临的两大瓶颈——严重降低模型性能和引入额外推理开销——进行了系统性研究。首先，作者构建了一个涵盖不同生成任务的综合基准，评估了9种代表性水印方法，发现现有方法主要针对文本流畅性设计，在受限或复杂任务上效果不佳，且推理延迟过高，难以用于延迟敏感系统。为解决这些问题，论文提出了一种针对混合专家模型（MoE）的水印方案 WaterMoE。不同于传统水印作为后处理令牌采样步骤，WaterMoE 在推理循环内部通过受控扰动影响每个路由器的专家选择，逐步累积到最终输出的令牌选择偏移，从而嵌入水印信号。该方法在 MoE 架构上几乎不引入额外的性能损失和计算开销。大量实验表明，WaterMoE 在水印保真度上接近无加水印的原始模型，并持续优于现有最先进方法，同时实现了最高4倍的加速，推理延迟仅比原生生成增加1%。该结果证明了 WaterMoE 在实际任务中部署的潜力。论文贡献包括：指出现有水印方法的性能-开销权衡问题；提出一种嵌入推理循环的 MoE 专属水印框架；通过全面实验验证了其高保真、高效率特性。适合对 LLM 安全部署、内容溯源、水印技术感兴趣的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 水印是防止LLM滥用和追溯内容来源的关键技术，但现有方案因性能开销实用化困难。WaterMoE提出了一种面向流行MoE架构的高效水印方法，几乎不牺牲模型质量或吞吐延迟，有望推动水印技术在真实场景中的大规模部署。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接应用于当前主流的MoE大模型（如Mixtral、DeepSeek等），提升内容溯源和滥用防护的可行性；其设计思路也可迁移至其他基于路由的结构化模型中。

items.title: Policy-Conditioned Constrained Decoding for Column-Level Access Control in Text-to-SQL
items.summary: Text-to-SQL is increasingly deployed across trust boundaries between data providers and users. Such deployment must balance three competing requirements: policy compliance, answer coverage, and bounded cost. Existing approaches typically decide refusal based on which columns a query mentions and enforce it stochastically. Whether a query is compliant, however, depends not only on which columns appear but on how they are used, and stochastic enforcement cannot deterministically rule out violations. We formalize this requirement as a column-use policy over semantic use: output, filter condition, and aggregation argument. We integrate the policy by aligning each role with grammar productions tracked by the decoder. The resulting system, PCC-SQL, applies a per-token logits mask that deterministically eliminates single-query column-use violations on the supported SQL fragment in a single decoding pass. Across three benchmarks and three open-source models, PCC-SQL achieves 0% Leakage Rate and Coverage up to 88.7% on Spider-CU, while staying within +10% tokens of direct prompting. We additionally assess semantic alignment with execution accuracy.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对 Text-to-SQL 系统在跨信任边界部署时面临的策略合规、答案覆盖率和成本三者平衡问题。现有方法通常基于查询涉及哪些列来随机决定是否拒绝，而未考虑列的使用方式，且随机执行无法确定性排除违规。作者形式化了列使用策略，将列的使用分为三种语义角色：输出、过滤条件和聚合参数。通过将每种角色与解码器跟踪的语法产生式对齐，提出了 PCC-SQL 系统。该系统在单次解码过程中，应用每个 token 的 logits 掩码，确定性消除所支持的 SQL 片段中的单查询列使用违规。在三个基准测试和三个开源模型上的实验表明，PCC-SQL 在 Spider-CU 上实现了 0% 的泄漏率和高达 88.7% 的覆盖率，同时解码令牌数仅比直接提示多 10% 以内。此外，还通过执行准确率评估了语义对齐。该研究为 Text-to-SQL 中的细粒度列级访问控制提供了新的确定性方法，适合数据库安全、LLM 应用安全领域的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: PCC-SQL 提出了一种确定性且高效的列级访问控制方法，解决了 Text-to-SQL 部署中策略合规的关键挑战，为敏感数据保护提供了可证明的安全保障。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于任何需要细粒度列访问控制的数据库查询系统，如金融、医疗等领域的数据分析平台，降低数据泄露风险。

items.why_it_matters: PCC-SQL 提出了一种确定性且高效的列级访问控制方法，解决了 Text-to-SQL 部署中策略合规的关键挑战，为敏感数据保护提供了可证明的安全保障。

items.title: Skills That Don't Exist: A Large-Scale Study of Hallucinated Skill Recommendation in LLM Agents
items.summary: LLM agents acquire new capabilities by downloading skills from open registries. Instead of browsing these catalogs manually, developers typically ask the agent to recommend and install a skill. This convenience hides a risk: agents frequently invent names for skills that exist in no registry. We term this flaw skill name hallucination. A fake name may seem harmless, but it opens the door to supply-chain attacks. Because registries rarely verify publishers, an adversary can prompt the agent, collect the fake names it returns, pre-register malicious skills under them, and wait for a victim to install the payload. We conducted the first large-scale measurement of skill name hallucination, evaluating 15,000 prompts across 12 configurations (4 standalone LLMs and 8 agents). We conservatively counted a name as hallucinated only if it was missing from all live registries and GitHub. The results reveal a systemic vulnerability: every configuration hallucinates. Rates average 36.0% for standalone LLMs and 36.9% for agents, rising to 43.1% on real-world developer questions. In total, the systems generated 5,669 distinct hallucinated names. Crucially, these names are not random noise. Agents repeat the same fake names across prompts and models, giving attackers highly reliable targets to hijack. Finally, we tested four model-level defenses and found a severe conflict between security and usability. The strongest, retrieval grounding, cut the hallucination rate from 40.8% to 3.2% but crippled usefulness: even the best-defended system recommended the correct skill only about one in six times. Skill name hallucination is thus a highly exploitable vulnerability requiring minimal attacker effort. Fixing it cannot rely on prompt engineering or model tuning alone. It demands ecosystem-wide structural changes: registry-level name reservations and verified recommendation pipelines.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文首次大规模研究了LLM智能体在推荐技能时出现的“技能名称幻觉”问题。智能体通常通过从开放注册表下载技能来获取新能力，开发者会要求智能体推荐并安装技能，但智能体经常编造注册表中不存在的技能名称。这种幻觉看似无害，却为供应链攻击打开了大门：由于注册表很少验证发布者，攻击者可以诱导智能体生成虚构名称，然后预先注册恶意技能，等待受害者安装。作者对15,000个提示进行了实验，涵盖12种配置（4个独立LLM和8个智能体），保守地将所有活跃注册表和GitHub上不存在的名称视为幻觉。结果显示，所有配置都存在幻觉，独立LLM的幻觉率平均为36.0%，智能体为36.9%，对真实世界开发者提问的幻觉率高达43.1%。系统总共生成了5,669个不同的幻觉名称，且这些名称并非随机噪音——智能体在不同提示和模型间重复相同的虚假名称，为攻击者提供了高度可靠的目标。作者测试了四种模型级防御，发现安全与可用性之间存在严重冲突：最强的防御（检索接地）将幻觉率从40.8%降至3.2%，但严重损害了实用性，最佳防御系统仅在大约六分之一的情况下推荐正确技能。因此，技能名称幻觉是一个高度可利用的漏洞，攻击者只需很少的努力。修复不能仅依赖提示工程或模型调优，需要生态系统的结构性变革，如注册表级名称预留和经过验证的推荐管道。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了LLM智能体生态中一个未被重视的供应链攻击面，攻击者可以低成本劫持智能体的技能安装流程，影响所有依赖技能推荐系统的用户和组织。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响任何允许LLM智能体从公共注册表推荐和安装技能的应用，如自动化开发助手、AI代理平台等。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，关注注册表级防御措施的行业实践，评估自身智能体系统的幻觉风险。
